timeline.summary: Goldiam International launched India's first digital 3D ring builder platform for its lab-grown diamond retail brand Origem on May 6, 2026.
Goldiam reported Q4FY26 monitoring agency report showing ₹26.91 Cr utilized out of ₹202.05 Cr QIP proceeds with store rollout delayed.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹234.6 Cr (+18.1% YoY), net profit ₹37.23 Cr (+60.6% YoY).
Goldiam reported record FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,021.2 Cr (+27.5% YoY) and PAT of ₹170.6 Cr (+45.7% YoY), proposed a 1:3 bonus issue, and doubled ORIGEM stores to 24.
Goldiam International hosted its Q4FY27 earnings call on May 27, 2026, guiding for double-digit revenue growth in FY27 and expansion of ORIGEM stores to 45-50.
Goldiam International opened its 25th ORIGEM lab-grown diamond retail store in Udaipur on June 8, 2026.
